return req.headers.get(PROTOCOL.authHeader) || "";
}

// FIX 2: Use PHOENIXMASTERKEY (matches v7.0 script)
function assertAuth(env, req){
const expected = String(env.PHOENIXMASTERKEY || "");
if (!expected) throw new Error("SERVER_MISCONFIG_NO_KEY");
const got = getAuthKey(req);
if (!ctEq(got, expected)) throw new Error("AUTH_FORBIDDEN");
}

// FIX 5: Use D1 autoincrement for nonce (no race conditions)
async function nextNonce(env){
// Insert dummy row to get autoincrement ID
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO nonce_seq DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id"
).run();
return res.results[0].id;
}

/* LEDGER APPEND */

async function getHeadHash(env){
return (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH)) || "0".repeat(64);
}

async function setHeadHash(env, h){
await env.KV.put(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH, String(h));
}

async function appendLedger(env, evt){
const energy = await energyGate(env);

if (evt.idempotency_key) {
const row = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id FROM ledger WHERE idempotency_key = ? LIMIT 1"
).bind(evt.idempotency_key).first();
if (row?.id) {
const head = await getHeadHash(env);
return { status: "OK_IDEMPOTENT", head_hash: head, energy };
}
}

const nonce = await nextNonce(env);
const prev_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const payload_json = canonicalJSON(evt.payload);

const core = {
id: evt.id,
at_utc_ms: evt.at_utc_ms,
type: evt.type,
actor: evt.actor,
scope: evt.scope,
severity: evt.severity,
source: evt.source,
request_id: evt.request_id,
idempotency_key: evt.idempotency_key,
payload_json,
nonce,
prev_hash,
};

const hash = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
const created_at_utc_ms = nowUtcMs();

await env.DB.prepare(  INSERT INTO ledger (   id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key,   payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot, created_at_utc_ms   ) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)  ).bind(
evt.id, evt.at_utc_ms, evt.type, evt.actor, evt.scope, evt.severity, evt.source,
evt.request_id, evt.idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy, created_at_utc_ms
).run();

await setHeadHash(env, hash);

return { status: "OK", hash, prev_hash, nonce, energy };
}

/* READ APIS */

async function introspectState(env){
const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const energy = await readEnergy(env);
const state = (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.STATE)) || STATES.SEALED;
const last_nonce = Number(await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.LAST_NONCE) || "0");
return {
status:"OK",
system:PROTOCOL.name,
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
state,
head_hash,
last_nonce,
energy
};
}

async function timeline(env, { scope=null, type=null, limit=50, cursor_at=null }){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(limit)||50));
let sql = "SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot FROM ledger";
const w = [];
const b = [];
if (scope){ w.push("scope = ?"); b.push(scope); }
if (type){ w.push("type = ?"); b.push(type); }
if (cursor_at !== null){ w.push("at_utc_ms < ?"); b.push(Number(cursor_at)); }
if (w.length) sql += " WHERE " + w.join(" AND ");
sql += " ORDER BY at_utc_ms DESC LIMIT ?";
b.push(L);

const res = await env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...b).all();
const events = (res.results || []).map(r => Object.freeze({
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash,
hash:r.hash, energy_snapshot:r.energy_snapshot
}));
const next_cursor = events.length ? events[events.length-1].at_utc_ms : null;
return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, events, next_cursor };
}

/* VERIFY */

async function verifyLedger(env, { limit=5000 } = {}){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(50000, Number(limit)||5000));
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash FROM ledger ORDER BY at_utc_ms ASC LIMIT ?"
).bind(L).all();

const rows = res.results || [];
const errors = [];
let prev = "0".repeat(64);

for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
const r = rows[i];
if (r.prev_hash !== prev) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"CHAIN_BREAK", expected_prev:prev, got_prev:r.prev_hash, id:r.id });
}
const core = {
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, payload_json:r.payload_json,
nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash
};
const recomputed = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
if (recomputed !== r.hash) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"HASH_MISMATCH", id:r.id, expected:recomputed, got:r.hash });
}
prev = r.hash;
}

const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const ok = errors.length === 0;

return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, ok, scanned:rows.length, head_hash, errors };
}

async function auditExport(env, { limit=200 } = {}){
const t = await timeline(env, { limit });
return {
status:"OK",
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
exported_at_utc_ms: nowUtcMs(),
...t
};
}

/* CHAOS + DRONES */

async function cronDroneLoop(env){
const tl = await timeline(env, { limit:100 });
const events = tl.events || [];
const errorCount = events.filter(e => e.severity === "ERROR" || e.type === "ERROR").length;
const successCount = events.filter(e => e.type === "SUCCESS").length;

let energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (errorCount > 5) energy -= 10;
if (successCount > 50) energy += 5;
energy = await writeEnergy(env, energy);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_DRONE",
type: "DRONE_TICK",
actor: "DRONE_LOOP",
scope: "system",
severity: "INFO",
source: "cron",
payload: { errorCount, successCount, energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", energy };
}

async function cronChaosLoop(env){
const chaosEnabled = String(env.CHAOS_ENABLED || "") === "1";
if (!chaosEnabled) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"CHAOS_DISABLED" };

const energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (energy < 50) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"MERCY_ENERGY_LOW", energy };

const hit = (Math.floor(Math.random()*10) === 0);
if (!hit) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"DICE_MISS", energy };

await sleep(250);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_CHAOS",
type: "CHAOS_STRIKE",
actor: "CHAOS_MONKEY",
scope: "system",
severity: "WARN",
source: "cron",
payload: { action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy };
}

/* WORKER HANDLERS */

// FIX 4: Body size limit
async function json(req){
const ct = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";
if (!ct.includes("application/json")) throw new Error("INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE");

const length = req.headers.get("content-length");
if (length && Number(length) > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
throw new Error("BODY_TOO_LARGE");
}

return await req.json();
}

// FIX 3: CORS headers
function responseJson(obj, status=200){
return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
status,
headers: {
"content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key"
}
});
}

function responseText(txt, status=200){
return new Response(String(txt), {
status,
headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }
});
}

export default {
async fetch(req, env){
try{
// FIX 3: CORS preflight
if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
return new Response(null, {
status: 204,
headers: {
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key",
"Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400"
}
});
}

const url = new URL(req.url);  
  const path = url.pathname;  

  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/state") {  
    return responseJson(await introspectState(env));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/timeline"){  
    const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope");  
    const type = url.searchParams.get("type");  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit");  
    const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor_at");  
    return responseJson(await timeline(env, { scope, type, limit, cursor_at: cursor }));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/health") {  
    return responseJson({ status:"OK", ok:true, protocol:PROTOCOL.version, time: nowUtcMs() });  
  }  

  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/audit/export"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 200;  
    return responseJson(await auditExport(env, { limit }));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/ledger/verify"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 5000;  
    return responseJson(await verifyLedger(env, { limit }));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/admin/schema/apply"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    await env.DB.exec(D1_SCHEMA_SQL);  
    return responseJson({ status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, applied:true });  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/gem"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const body = await json(req);  
    const evt = makeEventEnvelope({  
      id: body.id,  
      type: "GEM_CAPTURED",  
      actor: body.actor || "unknown",  
      scope: body.scope || "global",  
      severity: body.severity || "INFO",  
      source: "ingest_gem",  
      request_id: body.request_id || null,  
      idempotency_key: body.idempotency_key || null,  
      at_utc_ms: body.at_utc_ms || nowUtcMs(),  
      payload: body.payload ?? body  
    });  
    return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/emit"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const body = await json(req);  
    const evt = makeEventEnvelope(body);  
    return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/audio"){  
    return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("AUDIO_INGEST_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN", "Upload contract not provided"), 422);  
  }  

  return responseText("NOT_FOUND", 404);  
} catch(e){  
  const msg = String(e?.message || e);  
  if (msg === "AUTH_FORBIDDEN") return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("FORBIDDEN"), 403);  
  if (msg.startsWith("INVALID_") || msg.includes("CONTENT_TYPE") || msg.includes("BODY_TOO_LARGE")) {  
    return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("BAD_REQUEST", msg), 400);  
  }  
  if (msg.includes("MPCP_HALT")) return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("MPCP_HALT", msg), 409);  
  return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("PANIC", msg), 500);  
}

},

async scheduled(event, env){
try{ await cronDroneLoop(env); } catch(){}
try{ await cronChaosLoop(env); } catch(){}
}
};

/**

Factory function - creates DB interface bound to env.DB

@param {Object} env - Cloudflare Worker environment bindings

@returns {Object} Database interface with appendEvent method
*/
export function makeDb(env) {
if (!env?.DB) {
throw new Error("DB_BINDING_MISSING: env.DB is required");
}

/**

Append event to immutable ledger

@param {string} type - Event type (e.g., "AUDIO_INGEST", "CHAOS_EVENT")

@param {string} actor - Actor identity (e.g., "MICHAEL", "DRONE_A")

@param {any} data - Event payload (will be JSON stringified)

@param {number|null} energy_snapshot - MPCP energy at time of event (0-100)

@param {string|null} hash - SHA-256 hash for integrity (optional in Phase 1)

@returns {Promise<Object>} Result with { id, ok, meta }
*/
async function appendEvent(type, actor, data, energy_snapshot = null, hash = null) {
// Validation
if (!type || typeof type !== 'string') {
throw new Error("INVALID_TYPE: must be non-empty string");
}
if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'string') {
throw new Error("INVALID_ACTOR: must be non-empty string");
}

// Generate unique ID
const id = crypto.randomUUID();

// Serialize payload
const payload = typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data);

// Insert into ledger
const stmt = env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO ledger (id, type, actor, data, energy_snapshot, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
).bind(id, type, actor, payload, energy_snapshot, hash);

const res = await stmt.run();

return {
id,
ok: res.success || false,
meta: res.meta || {}
};

}

/**

Query recent events (read-only, for Phase 4 dashboard)

@param {number} limit - Max events to return (default 50)

@returns {Promise<Array>} Array of event objects
*/
async function getRecentEvents(limit = 50) {
const stmt = env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id, ts, type, actor, data, energy_snapshot, hash FROM ledger ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?"
).bind(Math.min(limit, 200));

const res = await stmt.all();
return res.results || [];

}

return {
appendEvent,
getRecentEvents
};
}-- PHOENIX EMPIRE LEDGER SCHEMA (PHASE 1)

throw new Error("INVALID_ACTOR: must be non-empty string");
}


// Generate unique ID

  "INSERT INTO ledger (id, type, actor, data, energy_snapshot, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"  
).bind(id, type, actor, payload, energy_snapshot, hash);

).bind(Math.min(limit, 200));


const res = await stmt.all();  
return res.results || [];

}

return {
appendEvent,
getRecentEvents
};

"use strict";

const PROTOCOL = Object.freeze({
name: "PHOENIX_CS_EDGE",
version: "OMEGA_SEED_V1",
time: "UTC_MS",
hash: "SHA-256",
authHeader: "x-deathstar-key",
});

const STATES = Object.freeze({
SEALED: "SEALED",
ARMED: "ARMED",
PANIC: "PANIC",
});

const ERR = Object.freeze({
REJECT: (fault, detail = null) => ({
status: "REJECT",
fault,
detail,
protocol: PROTOCOL.version
}),
});

const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

/* CRYPTO */

function isObject(x){ return x !== null && typeof x === "object" && !Array.isArray(x); }

function canonicalJSON(x){
if (x === null) return "null";
if (typeof x !== "object") return JSON.stringify(x);
if (Array.isArray(x)) return "[" + x.map(canonicalJSON).join(",") + "]";
const keys = Object.keys(x).sort();
return "{" + keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonicalJSON(x[k])).join(",") + "}";
}

async function sha256Hex(str){
if (globalThis.crypto?.subtle?.digest) {
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const buf = enc.encode(str);
const digest = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
const bytes = new Uint8Array(digest);
return Array.from(bytes).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
const crypto = require("crypto");
return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

// FIX 1: Constant-time comparison
function ctEq(a, b) {
a = String(a || "");
b = String(b || "");
if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
let c = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
c |= (a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i));
}
return c === 0;
}

/* EVENT ENVELOPE */

function nowUtcMs(){ return Date.now(); }

function requireStr(v, name, min=1, max=256){
const s = String(v ?? "");
if (s.length < min || s.length > max) throw new Error("INVALID_" + name);
return s;
}

function requireInt(v, name, min=0, max=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER){
const n = Number(v);
if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max) throw new Error("INVALID_" + name);
return n;
}

function makeEventEnvelope(input){
const type = requireStr(input.type, "TYPE", 1, 64);
const actor = requireStr(input.actor, "ACTOR", 1, 128);
const scope = String(input.scope ?? "global").slice(0,128);
const severity = String(input.severity ?? "INFO").slice(0,16);
const source = String(input.source ?? "unknown").slice(0,64);
const at_utc_ms = requireInt(input.at_utc_ms ?? nowUtcMs(), "AT_UTC_MS", 1);
const request_id = String(input.request_id ?? "").slice(0,64) || null;
const payload = input.payload;
if (payload === undefined) throw new Error("INVALID_PAYLOAD_UNDEFINED");
const idem = String(input.idempotency_key ?? "").slice(0,128) || null;

return Object.freeze({
id: requireStr(input.id, "ID", 8, 64),
at_utc_ms,
type,
actor,
scope,
severity,
source,
request_id,
idempotency_key: idem,
payload,
});
}

/* STORAGE */

const D1_SCHEMA_SQL = 
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ledger (
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
at_utc_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
type TEXT NOT NULL,
actor TEXT NOT NULL,
scope TEXT NOT NULL,
severity TEXT NOT NULL,
source TEXT NOT NULL,
request_id TEXT,
idempotency_key TEXT,
payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
nonce INTEGER NOT NULL,
prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
hash TEXT NOT NULL,
energy_snapshot INTEGER,
created_at_utc_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_nonce ON ledger(nonce);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_type_time ON ledger(type, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_scope_time ON ledger(scope, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_actor_time ON ledger(actor, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_idem ON ledger(idempotency_key);
;

const KV_KEYS = Object.freeze({
ENERGY: "ENERGY",
STATE: "SYSTEM_STATE",
LAST_NONCE: "LAST_NONCE",
HEAD_HASH: "HEAD_HASH",
});

/* ENERGY (MPCP) */

const MPCP = Object.freeze({
CRITICAL_LOW: 10,
THROTTLE: 30,
MAX: 100,
RECOVERY_RATE_PER_MIN: 1,
});

function sleep(ms){ return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function readEnergy(env){
const raw = await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.ENERGY);
const n = raw === null ? MPCP.MAX : Number(raw);
return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(MPCP.MAX, Math.floor(n))) : MPCP.MAX;
}

async function writeEnergy(env, n){
const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(MPCP.MAX, Math.floor(n)));
await env.KV.put(KV_KEYS.ENERGY, String(v));
return v;
}

async function energyGate(env){
const energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (energy < MPCP.CRITICAL_LOW) throw new Error("MPCP_HALT_SYSTEM_EXHAUSTED");
if (energy < MPCP.THROTTLE) await sleep(500);
return energy;
}

/* AUTH */

function getAuthKey(req){
return req.headers.get(PROTOCOL.authHeader) || "";
}

// FIX 2: Use PHOENIXMASTERKEY (matches v7.0 script)
function assertAuth(env, req){
const expected = String(env.PHOENIXMASTERKEY || "");
if (!expected) throw new Error("SERVER_MISCONFIG_NO_KEY");
const got = getAuthKey(req);
if (!ctEq(got, expected)) throw new Error("AUTH_FORBIDDEN");
}

// FIX 5: Use D1 autoincrement for nonce (no race conditions)
async function nextNonce(env){
// Insert dummy row to get autoincrement ID
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO nonce_seq DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id"
).run();
return res.results[0].id;
}

/* LEDGER APPEND */

async function getHeadHash(env){
return (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH)) || "0".repeat(64);
}

async function setHeadHash(env, h){
await env.KV.put(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH, String(h));
}

async function appendLedger(env, evt){
const energy = await energyGate(env);

if (evt.idempotency_key) {
const row = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id FROM ledger WHERE idempotency_key = ? LIMIT 1"
).bind(evt.idempotency_key).first();
if (row?.id) {
const head = await getHeadHash(env);
return { status: "OK_IDEMPOTENT", head_hash: head, energy };
}
}

const nonce = await nextNonce(env);
const prev_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const payload_json = canonicalJSON(evt.payload);

const core = {
id: evt.id,
at_utc_ms: evt.at_utc_ms,
type: evt.type,
actor: evt.actor,
scope: evt.scope,
severity: evt.severity,
source: evt.source,
request_id: evt.request_id,
idempotency_key: evt.idempotency_key,
payload_json,
nonce,
prev_hash,
};

const hash = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
const created_at_utc_ms = nowUtcMs();

await env.DB.prepare(  INSERT INTO ledger (   id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key,   payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot, created_at_utc_ms   ) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)  ).bind(
evt.id, evt.at_utc_ms, evt.type, evt.actor, evt.scope, evt.severity, evt.source,
evt.request_id, evt.idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy, created_at_utc_ms
).run();

await setHeadHash(env, hash);

return { status: "OK", hash, prev_hash, nonce, energy };
}

/* READ APIS */

async function introspectState(env){
const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const energy = await readEnergy(env);
const state = (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.STATE)) || STATES.SEALED;
const last_nonce = Number(await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.LAST_NONCE) || "0");
return {
status:"OK",
system:PROTOCOL.name,
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
state,
head_hash,
last_nonce,
energy
};
}

async function timeline(env, { scope=null, type=null, limit=50, cursor_at=null }){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(limit)||50));
let sql = "SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot FROM ledger";
const w = [];
const b = [];
if (scope){ w.push("scope = ?"); b.push(scope); }
if (type){ w.push("type = ?"); b.push(type); }
if (cursor_at !== null){ w.push("at_utc_ms < ?"); b.push(Number(cursor_at)); }
if (w.length) sql += " WHERE " + w.join(" AND ");
sql += " ORDER BY at_utc_ms DESC LIMIT ?";
b.push(L);

const res = await env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...b).all();
const events = (res.results || []).map(r => Object.freeze({
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash,
hash:r.hash, energy_snapshot:r.energy_snapshot
}));
const next_cursor = events.length ? events[events.length-1].at_utc_ms : null;
return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, events, next_cursor };
}

/* VERIFY */

async function verifyLedger(env, { limit=5000 } = {}){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(50000, Number(limit)||5000));
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash FROM ledger ORDER BY at_utc_ms ASC LIMIT ?"
).bind(L).all();

const rows = res.results || [];
const errors = [];
let prev = "0".repeat(64);

for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
const r = rows[i];
if (r.prev_hash !== prev) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"CHAIN_BREAK", expected_prev:prev, got_prev:r.prev_hash, id:r.id });
}
const core = {
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, payload_json:r.payload_json,
nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash
};
const recomputed = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
if (recomputed !== r.hash) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"HASH_MISMATCH", id:r.id, expected:recomputed, got:r.hash });
}
prev = r.hash;
}

const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const ok = errors.length === 0;

return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, ok, scanned:rows.length, head_hash, errors };
}

async function auditExport(env, { limit=200 } = {}){
const t = await timeline(env, { limit });
return {
status:"OK",
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
exported_at_utc_ms: nowUtcMs(),
...t
};
}

/* CHAOS + DRONES */

async function cronDroneLoop(env){
const tl = await timeline(env, { limit:100 });
const events = tl.events || [];
const errorCount = events.filter(e => e.severity === "ERROR" || e.type === "ERROR").length;
const successCount = events.filter(e => e.type === "SUCCESS").length;

let energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (errorCount > 5) energy -= 10;
if (successCount > 50) energy += 5;
energy = await writeEnergy(env, energy);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_DRONE",
type: "DRONE_TICK",
actor: "DRONE_LOOP",
scope: "system",
severity: "INFO",
source: "cron",
payload: { errorCount, successCount, energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", energy };
}

async function cronChaosLoop(env){
const chaosEnabled = String(env.CHAOS_ENABLED || "") === "1";
if (!chaosEnabled) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"CHAOS_DISABLED" };

const energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (energy < 50) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"MERCY_ENERGY_LOW", energy };

const hit = (Math.floor(Math.random()*10) === 0);
if (!hit) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"DICE_MISS", energy };

await sleep(250);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_CHAOS",
type: "CHAOS_STRIKE",
actor: "CHAOS_MONKEY",
scope: "system",
severity: "WARN",
source: "cron",
payload: { action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy };
}

/* WORKER HANDLERS */

// FIX 4: Body size limit
async function json(req){
const ct = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";
if (!ct.includes("application/json")) throw new Error("INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE");

const length = req.headers.get("content-length");
if (length && Number(length) > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
throw new Error("BODY_TOO_LARGE");
}

return await req.json();
}

// FIX 3: CORS headers
function responseJson(obj, status=200){
return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
status,
headers: {
"content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key"
}
});
}

function responseText(txt, status=200){
return new Response(String(txt), {
status,
headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }
});
}

export default {
async fetch(req, env){
try{
// FIX 3: CORS preflight
if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
return new Response(null, {
status: 204,
headers: {
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key",
"Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400"
}
});
}

const url = new URL(req.url);  
  const path = url.pathname;  

  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/state") {  
    return responseJson(await introspectState(env));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/timeline"){  
    const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope");  
    const type = url.searchParams.get("type");  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit");  
    const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor_at");  
    return responseJson(await timeline(env, { scope, type, limit, cursor_at: cursor }));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/health") {  
    return responseJson({ status:"OK", ok:true, protocol:PROTOCOL.version, time: nowUtcMs() });  
  }  

  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/audit/export"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 200;  
    return responseJson(await auditExport(env, { limit }));  
  }  
    
  if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/ledger/verify"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 5000;  
    return responseJson(await verifyLedger(env, { limit }));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/admin/schema/apply"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    await env.DB.exec(D1_SCHEMA_SQL);  
    return responseJson({ status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, applied:true });  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/gem"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const body = await json(req);  
    const evt = makeEventEnvelope({  
      id: body.id,  
      type: "GEM_CAPTURED",  
      actor: body.actor || "unknown",  
      scope: body.scope || "global",  
      severity: body.severity || "INFO",  
      source: "ingest_gem",  
      request_id: body.request_id || null,  
      idempotency_key: body.idempotency_key || null,  
      at_utc_ms: body.at_utc_ms || nowUtcMs(),  
      payload: body.payload ?? body  
    });  
    return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/emit"){  
    assertAuth(env, req);  
    const body = await json(req);  
    const evt = makeEventEnvelope(body);  
    return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));  
  }  

  if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/audio"){  
    return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("AUDIO_INGEST_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN", "Upload contract not provided"), 422);  
  }  

  return responseText("NOT_FOUND", 404);  
} catch(e){  
  const msg = String(e?.message || e);  
  if (msg === "AUTH_FORBIDDEN") return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("FORBIDDEN"), 403);  
  if (msg.startsWith("INVALID_") || msg.includes("CONTENT_TYPE") || msg.includes("BODY_TOO_LARGE")) {  
    return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("BAD_REQUEST", msg), 400);  
  }  
  if (msg.includes("MPCP_HALT")) return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("MPCP_HALT", msg), 409);  
  return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("PANIC", msg), 500);  
}

},

async scheduled(event, env){
try{ await cronDroneLoop(env); } catch(){}
try{ await cronChaosLoop(env); } catch(){}
}
};

/**

Factory function - creates DB interface bound to env.DB

@param {Object} env - Cloudflare Worker environment bindings

@returns {Object} Database interface with appendEvent method
*/
export function makeDb(env) {
if (!env?.DB) {
throw new Error("DB_BINDING_MISSING: env.DB is required");
}

/**

Append event to immutable ledger

@param {string} type - Event type (e.g., "AUDIO_INGEST", "CHAOS_EVENT")

@param {string} actor - Actor identity (e.g., "MICHAEL", "DRONE_A")

@param {any} data - Event payload (will be JSON stringified)

@param {number|null} energy_snapshot - MPCP energy at time of event (0-100)

@param {string|null} hash - SHA-256 hash for integrity (optional in Phase 1)

@returns {Promise<Object>} Result with { id, ok, meta }
*/
async function appendEvent(type, actor, data, energy_snapshot = null, hash = null) {
// Validation
if (!type || typeof type !== 'string') {
throw new Error("INVALID_TYPE: must be non-empty string");
}
if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'string') {
throw new Error("INVALID_ACTOR: must be non-empty string");
}

// Generate unique ID
const id = crypto.randomUUID();

// Serialize payload
const payload = typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data);

// Insert into ledger
const stmt = env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO ledger (id, type, actor, data, energy_snapshot, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
).bind(id, type, actor, payload, energy_snapshot, hash);

const res = await stmt.run();

return {
id,
ok: res.success || false,
meta: res.meta || {}
};

}

/**

Query recent events (read-only, for Phase 4 dashboard)

@param {number} limit - Max events to return (default 50)

@returns {Promise<Array>} Array of event objects
*/
async function getRecentEvents(limit = 50) {
const stmt = env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id, ts, type, actor, data, energy_snapshot, hash FROM ledger ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?"
).bind(Math.min(limit, 200));

const res = await stmt.all();
return res.results || [];

}

return {
appendEvent,
getRecentEvents
};

"use strict";

const PROTOCOL = Object.freeze({
name: "PHOENIX_CS_EDGE",
version: "OMEGA_SEED_V1",
time: "UTC_MS",
hash: "SHA-256",
authHeader: "x-deathstar-key",
});

const STATES = Object.freeze({
SEALED: "SEALED",
ARMED: "ARMED",
PANIC: "PANIC",
});

const ERR = Object.freeze({
REJECT: (fault, detail = null) => ({
status: "REJECT",
fault,
detail,
protocol: PROTOCOL.version
}),
});

const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

/* CRYPTO */

function isObject(x){ return x !== null && typeof x === "object" && !Array.isArray(x); }

function canonicalJSON(x){
if (x === null) return "null";
if (typeof x !== "object") return JSON.stringify(x);
if (Array.isArray(x)) return "[" + x.map(canonicalJSON).join(",") + "]";
const keys = Object.keys(x).sort();
return "{" + keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonicalJSON(x[k])).join(",") + "}";
}

async function sha256Hex(str){
if (globalThis.crypto?.subtle?.digest) {
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const buf = enc.encode(str);
const digest = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
const bytes = new Uint8Array(digest);
return Array.from(bytes).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
const crypto = require("crypto");
return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

// FIX 1: Constant-time comparison
function ctEq(a, b) {
a = String(a || "");
b = String(b || "");
if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
let c = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
c |= (a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i));
}
return c === 0;
}

/* EVENT ENVELOPE */

function nowUtcMs(){ return Date.now(); }

function requireStr(v, name, min=1, max=256){
const s = String(v ?? "");
if (s.length < min || s.length > max) throw new Error("INVALID_" + name);
return s;
}

function requireInt(v, name, min=0, max=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER){
const n = Number(v);
if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max) throw new Error("INVALID_" + name);
return n;
}

function makeEventEnvelope(input){
const type = requireStr(input.type, "TYPE", 1, 64);
const actor = requireStr(input.actor, "ACTOR", 1, 128);
const scope = String(input.scope ?? "global").slice(0,128);
const severity = String(input.severity ?? "INFO").slice(0,16);
const source = String(input.source ?? "unknown").slice(0,64);
const at_utc_ms = requireInt(input.at_utc_ms ?? nowUtcMs(), "AT_UTC_MS", 1);
const request_id = String(input.request_id ?? "").slice(0,64) || null;
const payload = input.payload;
if (payload === undefined) throw new Error("INVALID_PAYLOAD_UNDEFINED");
const idem = String(input.idempotency_key ?? "").slice(0,128) || null;

return Object.freeze({
id: requireStr(input.id, "ID", 8, 64),
at_utc_ms,
type,
actor,
scope,
severity,
source,
request_id,
idempotency_key: idem,
payload,
});
}

/* STORAGE */

const D1_SCHEMA_SQL = 
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ledger (
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
at_utc_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
type TEXT NOT NULL,
actor TEXT NOT NULL,
scope TEXT NOT NULL,
severity TEXT NOT NULL,
source TEXT NOT NULL,
request_id TEXT,
idempotency_key TEXT,
payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
nonce INTEGER NOT NULL,
prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
hash TEXT NOT NULL,
energy_snapshot INTEGER,
created_at_utc_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_nonce ON ledger(nonce);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_type_time ON ledger(type, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_scope_time ON ledger(scope, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_actor_time ON ledger(actor, at_utc_ms);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_idem ON ledger(idempotency_key);
;

const KV_KEYS = Object.freeze({
ENERGY: "ENERGY",
STATE: "SYSTEM_STATE",
LAST_NONCE: "LAST_NONCE",
HEAD_HASH: "HEAD_HASH",
});

/* ENERGY (MPCP) */

const MPCP = Object.freeze({
CRITICAL_LOW: 10,
THROTTLE: 30,
MAX: 100,
RECOVERY_RATE_PER_MIN: 1,
});

function sleep(ms){ return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function readEnergy(env){
const raw = await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.ENERGY);
const n = raw === null ? MPCP.MAX : Number(raw);
return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(MPCP.MAX, Math.floor(n))) : MPCP.MAX;
}

async function writeEnergy(env, n){
const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(MPCP.MAX, Math.floor(n)));
await env.KV.put(KV_KEYS.ENERGY, String(v));
return v;
}

async function energyGate(env){
const energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (energy < MPCP.CRITICAL_LOW) throw new Error("MPCP_HALT_SYSTEM_EXHAUSTED");
if (energy < MPCP.THROTTLE) await sleep(500);
return energy;
}

/* AUTH */

function getAuthKey(req){
return req.headers.get(PROTOCOL.authHeader) || "";
}

// FIX 2: Use PHOENIXMASTERKEY (matches v7.0 script)
function assertAuth(env, req){
const expected = String(env.PHOENIXMASTERKEY || "");
if (!expected) throw new Error("SERVER_MISCONFIG_NO_KEY");
const got = getAuthKey(req);
if (!ctEq(got, expected)) throw new Error("AUTH_FORBIDDEN");
}

// FIX 5: Use D1 autoincrement for nonce (no race conditions)
async function nextNonce(env){
// Insert dummy row to get autoincrement ID
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO nonce_seq DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id"
).run();
return res.results[0].id;
}

/* LEDGER APPEND */

async function getHeadHash(env){
return (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH)) || "0".repeat(64);
}

async function setHeadHash(env, h){
await env.KV.put(KV_KEYS.HEAD_HASH, String(h));
}

async function appendLedger(env, evt){
const energy = await energyGate(env);

if (evt.idempotency_key) {
const row = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id FROM ledger WHERE idempotency_key = ? LIMIT 1"
).bind(evt.idempotency_key).first();
if (row?.id) {
const head = await getHeadHash(env);
return { status: "OK_IDEMPOTENT", head_hash: head, energy };
}
}

const nonce = await nextNonce(env);
const prev_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const payload_json = canonicalJSON(evt.payload);

const core = {
id: evt.id,
at_utc_ms: evt.at_utc_ms,
type: evt.type,
actor: evt.actor,
scope: evt.scope,
severity: evt.severity,
source: evt.source,
request_id: evt.request_id,
idempotency_key: evt.idempotency_key,
payload_json,
nonce,
prev_hash,
};

const hash = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
const created_at_utc_ms = nowUtcMs();

await env.DB.prepare(  INSERT INTO ledger (   id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key,   payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot, created_at_utc_ms   ) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)  ).bind(
evt.id, evt.at_utc_ms, evt.type, evt.actor, evt.scope, evt.severity, evt.source,
evt.request_id, evt.idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy, created_at_utc_ms
).run();

await setHeadHash(env, hash);

return { status: "OK", hash, prev_hash, nonce, energy };
}

/* READ APIS */

async function introspectState(env){
const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const energy = await readEnergy(env);
const state = (await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.STATE)) || STATES.SEALED;
const last_nonce = Number(await env.KV.get(KV_KEYS.LAST_NONCE) || "0");
return {
status:"OK",
system:PROTOCOL.name,
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
state,
head_hash,
last_nonce,
energy
};
}

async function timeline(env, { scope=null, type=null, limit=50, cursor_at=null }){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(limit)||50));
let sql = "SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, nonce, prev_hash, hash, energy_snapshot FROM ledger";
const w = [];
const b = [];
if (scope){ w.push("scope = ?"); b.push(scope); }
if (type){ w.push("type = ?"); b.push(type); }
if (cursor_at !== null){ w.push("at_utc_ms < ?"); b.push(Number(cursor_at)); }
if (w.length) sql += " WHERE " + w.join(" AND ");
sql += " ORDER BY at_utc_ms DESC LIMIT ?";
b.push(L);

const res = await env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...b).all();
const events = (res.results || []).map(r => Object.freeze({
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash,
hash:r.hash, energy_snapshot:r.energy_snapshot
}));
const next_cursor = events.length ? events[events.length-1].at_utc_ms : null;
return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, events, next_cursor };
}

/* VERIFY */

async function verifyLedger(env, { limit=5000 } = {}){
const L = Math.max(1, Math.min(50000, Number(limit)||5000));
const res = await env.DB.prepare(
"SELECT id, at_utc_ms, type, actor, scope, severity, source, request_id, idempotency_key, payload_json, nonce, prev_hash, hash FROM ledger ORDER BY at_utc_ms ASC LIMIT ?"
).bind(L).all();

const rows = res.results || [];
const errors = [];
let prev = "0".repeat(64);

for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
const r = rows[i];
if (r.prev_hash !== prev) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"CHAIN_BREAK", expected_prev:prev, got_prev:r.prev_hash, id:r.id });
}
const core = {
id:r.id, at_utc_ms:r.at_utc_ms, type:r.type, actor:r.actor, scope:r.scope,
severity:r.severity, source:r.source, request_id:r.request_id,
idempotency_key:r.idempotency_key, payload_json:r.payload_json,
nonce:r.nonce, prev_hash:r.prev_hash
};
const recomputed = await sha256Hex(canonicalJSON(core));
if (recomputed !== r.hash) {
errors.push({ i, fault:"HASH_MISMATCH", id:r.id, expected:recomputed, got:r.hash });
}
prev = r.hash;
}

const head_hash = await getHeadHash(env);
const ok = errors.length === 0;

return { status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, ok, scanned:rows.length, head_hash, errors };
}

async function auditExport(env, { limit=200 } = {}){
const t = await timeline(env, { limit });
return {
status:"OK",
protocol:PROTOCOL.version,
exported_at_utc_ms: nowUtcMs(),
...t
};
}

/* CHAOS + DRONES */

async function cronDroneLoop(env){
const tl = await timeline(env, { limit:100 });
const events = tl.events || [];
const errorCount = events.filter(e => e.severity === "ERROR" || e.type === "ERROR").length;
const successCount = events.filter(e => e.type === "SUCCESS").length;

let energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (errorCount > 5) energy -= 10;
if (successCount > 50) energy += 5;
energy = await writeEnergy(env, energy);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_DRONE",
type: "DRONE_TICK",
actor: "DRONE_LOOP",
scope: "system",
severity: "INFO",
source: "cron",
payload: { errorCount, successCount, energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", energy };
}

async function cronChaosLoop(env){
const chaosEnabled = String(env.CHAOS_ENABLED || "") === "1";
if (!chaosEnabled) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"CHAOS_DISABLED" };

const energy = await readEnergy(env);
if (energy < 50) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"MERCY_ENERGY_LOW", energy };

const hit = (Math.floor(Math.random()*10) === 0);
if (!hit) return { status:"SKIP", reason:"DICE_MISS", energy };

await sleep(250);

await appendLedger(env, makeEventEnvelope({
id: "evt_" + nowUtcMs() + "_CHAOS",
type: "CHAOS_STRIKE",
actor: "CHAOS_MONKEY",
scope: "system",
severity: "WARN",
source: "cron",
payload: { action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy }
}));

return { status:"OK", action:"LATENCY_250MS", energy };
}

/* WORKER HANDLERS */

// FIX 4: Body size limit
async function json(req){
const ct = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";
if (!ct.includes("application/json")) throw new Error("INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE");

const length = req.headers.get("content-length");
if (length && Number(length) > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
throw new Error("BODY_TOO_LARGE");
}

return await req.json();
}

// FIX 3: CORS headers
function responseJson(obj, status=200){
return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
status,
headers: {
"content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key"
}
});
}

function responseText(txt, status=200){
return new Response(String(txt), {
status,
headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }
});
}

export default {
async fetch(req, env){
try{
// FIX 3: CORS preflight
if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
return new Response(null, {
status: 204,
headers: {
"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
"Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "content-type, x-deathstar-key",
"Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400"
}
});
}

const url = new URL(req.url);
const path = url.pathname;

if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/state") {
return responseJson(await introspectState(env));
}

if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/timeline"){
const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope");
const type = url.searchParams.get("type");
const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit");
const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor_at");
return responseJson(await timeline(env, { scope, type, limit, cursor_at: cursor }));
}

if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/introspect/health") {
return responseJson({ status:"OK", ok:true, protocol:PROTOCOL.version, time: nowUtcMs() });
}

if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/audit/export"){
assertAuth(env, req);
const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 200;
return responseJson(await auditExport(env, { limit }));
}

if (req.method === "GET" && path === "/ledger/verify"){
assertAuth(env, req);
const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") || 5000;
return responseJson(await verifyLedger(env, { limit }));
}

if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/admin/schema/apply"){
assertAuth(env, req);
await env.DB.exec(D1_SCHEMA_SQL);
return responseJson({ status:"OK", protocol:PROTOCOL.version, applied:true });
}

if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/gem"){
assertAuth(env, req);
const body = await json(req);
const evt = makeEventEnvelope({
id: body.id,
type: "GEM_CAPTURED",
actor: body.actor || "unknown",
scope: body.scope || "global",
severity: body.severity || "INFO",
source: "ingest_gem",
request_id: body.request_id || null,
idempotency_key: body.idempotency_key || null,
at_utc_ms: body.at_utc_ms || nowUtcMs(),
payload: body.payload ?? body
});
return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));
}

if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/emit"){
assertAuth(env, req);
const body = await json(req);
const evt = makeEventEnvelope(body);
return responseJson(await appendLedger(env, evt));
}

if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/ingest/audio"){
return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("AUDIO_INGEST_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN", "Upload contract not provided"), 422);
}

return responseText("NOT_FOUND", 404);
} catch(e){
const msg = String(e?.message || e);
if (msg === "AUTH_FORBIDDEN") return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("FORBIDDEN"), 403);
if (msg.startsWith("INVALID_") || msg.includes("CONTENT_TYPE") || msg.includes("BODY_TOO_LARGE")) {
return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("BAD_REQUEST", msg), 400);
}
if (msg.includes("MPCP_HALT")) return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("MPCP_HALT", msg), 409);
return responseJson(ERR.REJECT("PANIC", msg), 500);
}

},

async scheduled(event, env){
try{ await cronDroneLoop(env); } catch(){}
try{ await cronChaosLoop(env); } catch(){}
}
};

// builder/kernel.js
export const BuilderKernel = (() => {
  const state = {
    mode: "5IN1_BUILDER",
    locked: true,
    registry: [],
    gates: {
      preTokenLock: true,
      abortOnViolation: true,
      artifactRequiredForClaims: true,
      interruptSupremacy: true
    }
  };

  function addArtifact(meta){
    state.registry.push({
      id: meta.id,
      kind: meta.kind,
      status: meta.status || "DRAFT",
      sha256: meta.sha256 || "UNSEALED",
      notes: meta.notes || ""
    });
  }

  function assert(ok, reason){
    if (!ok) throw new Error("HALT:" + reason);
  }

  function interrupt(word){
    if (/(^|\s)(stop|only|now)(\s|$)/i.test(word)) {
      throw new Error("HALT:INTERRUPT_SUPREMACY");
    }
  }

  return { state, addArtifact, assert, interrupt };
})();
B) Execution Spine (task → artifact)
// builder/spine.js
import { BuilderKernel as K } from "./kernel.js";

export function execute(task){
  K.assert(K.state.locked, "MODE_NOT_LOCKED");
  K.interrupt(task.command || "");

  // route
  switch (task.type) {
    case "BLUEPRINT":
    case "SCHEMA":
    case "SCRIPT":
    case "CHECKLIST":
      K.addArtifact({ id: task.id, kind: task.type, status: "BUILT" });
      return { ok: true, artifact: task.id };
    default:
      K.assert(false, "UNKNOWN_TASK");
  }
}

// builder/kernel.js
export const BuilderKernel = (() => {
  const state = {
    mode: "5IN1_BUILDER",
    locked: true,
    registry: [],
    gates: {
      preTokenLock: true,
      abortOnViolation: true,
      artifactRequiredForClaims: true,
      interruptSupremacy: true
    }
  };

  function addArtifact(meta){
    state.registry.push({
      id: meta.id,
      kind: meta.kind,
      status: meta.status || "DRAFT",
      sha256: meta.sha256 || "UNSEALED",
      notes: meta.notes || ""
    });
  }

  function assert(ok, reason){
    if (!ok) throw new Error("HALT:" + reason);
  }

  function interrupt(word){
    if (/(^|\s)(stop|only|now)(\s|$)/i.test(word)) {
      throw new Error("HALT:INTERRUPT_SUPREMACY");
    }
  }

  return { state, addArtifact, assert, interrupt };
})();

B) Execution Spine (task → artifact)

// builder/spine.js
import { BuilderKernel as K } from "./kernel.js";

export function execute(task){
  K.assert(K.state.locked, "MODE_NOT_LOCKED");
  K.interrupt(task.command || "");

  // route
  switch (task.type) {
    case "BLUEPRINT":
    case "SCHEMA":
    case "SCRIPT":
    case "CHECKLIST":
      K.addArtifact({ id: task.id, kind: task.type, status: "BUILT" });
      return { ok: true, artifact: task.id };
    default:
      K.assert(false, "UNKNOWN_TASK");
  }
}

// builder/kernel.js
export const BuilderKernel = (() => {
  const state = {
    mode: "5IN1_BUILDER",
    locked: true,
    registry: [],
    gates: {
      preTokenLock: true,
      abortOnViolation: true,
      artifactRequiredForClaims: true,
      interruptSupremacy: true
    }
  };

  function addArtifact(meta){
    state.registry.push({
      id: meta.id,
      kind: meta.kind,
      status: meta.status || "DRAFT",
      sha256: meta.sha256 || "UNSEALED",
      notes: meta.notes || ""
    });
  }

  function assert(ok, reason){
    if (!ok) throw new Error("HALT:" + reason);
  }

  function interrupt(word){
    if (/(^|\s)(stop|only|now)(\s|$)/i.test(word)) {
      throw new Error("HALT:INTERRUPT_SUPREMACY");
    }
  }

  return { state, addArtifact, assert, interrupt };
})();

B) Execution Spine (task → artifact)

// builder/spine.js
import { BuilderKernel as K } from "./kernel.js";

export function execute(task){
  K.assert(K.state.locked, "MODE_NOT_LOCKED");
  K.interrupt(task.command || "");

  // route
  switch (task.type) {
    case "BLUEPRINT":
    case "SCHEMA":
    case "SCRIPT":
    case "CHECKLIST":
      K.addArtifact({ id: task.id, kind: task.type, status: "BUILT" });
      return { ok: true, artifact: task.id };
    default:
      K.assert(false, "UNKNOWN_TASK");
  }
}

export async function sha256Hex(input){
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const data = enc.encode(typeof input === "string" ? input : JSON.stringify(input));

}

// utils/sha256.js
export async function sha256Hex(input){
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const data = enc.encode(typeof input === "string" ? input : JSON.stringify(input));
const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

// builder/kernel.js (patch)
import { sha256Hex } from "../utils/sha256.js";

const addArtifact = async (meta) => {
const digest = await sha256Hex(meta);
state.registry.push({
id: meta.id,
kind: meta.kind,
status: meta.status ?? "BUILT",
sha256: digest,
notes: meta.notes ?? ""
});
};

// builder/persist.js
export async function persistArtifact(env, artifact){
await env.DB.prepare(
"INSERT INTO artifacts (id, kind, sha256, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, unixepoch())"
).bind(artifact.id, artifact.kind, artifact.sha256).run();
}

                    const seconds = Math.floor((elapsed % 60000) / 1000);
                    document.getElementById('uptime').textContent = 
                        ${hours.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')};
                    
                    // Update stats
                    document.getElementById('requestCount').textContent = this.stats.requests;

                    // Reload system state

            startMatrixRain() {
                const canvas = document.getElementById('matrixCanvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                
                canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
                
                const chars = '0123456789ABCDEF⚡🦅💎';
                const fontSize = 14;
                const columns = canvas.width / fontSize;
                const drops = Array(Math.floor(columns)).fill(1);
                
                function draw() {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
                    ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';
                    
                    for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                        const text = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
                        ctx.fillText(text, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);
                        
                        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
                            drops[i] = 0;
                        }
                        drops[i]++;
                    }
                }
                
                setInterval(draw, 50);
                
                window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
                });
            },
            
            sleep(ms) {
                return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
            }
        };
        
        // Initialize on load
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            MagicChat.init();
        });
    </script>

            color: var(--matrix-green);
        }
        
        /* Matrix Rain Effect */
        .matrix-canvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: -1;
            opacity: 0.1;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        
        /* Loading State */
        .loading {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gospel-purple);
            border-top-color: transparent;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
        }
        
        @keyframes spin {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Matrix Rain Canvas -->
    <canvas id="matrixCanvas" class="matrix-canvas"></canvas>
    
    <div class="container">
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="header">
            <div class="header-top">
                <div class="logo">⚡ PHOENIX EMPIRE</div>
                <div class="status-badge online">
                    <span id="systemStatus">◉ SYSTEM ONLINE</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="header-stats">
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-label">Protocol</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="protocolVersion">OMEGA v1</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-label">Ledger Height</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="ledgerHeight">--</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-label">State</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="systemState">SHADOW</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item">
                    <div class="stat-label">Uptime</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="uptime">00:00:00</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Main Grid -->
        <div class="main-grid">
            <!-- Sidebar -->
            <div class="panel">
                <div class="panel-title">⚡ ENERGY MATRIX</div>
                
                <div class="energy-container">
                    <div class="energy-value" id="energyValue">100%</div>
                    <div class="energy-bar">
                        <div class="energy-fill" id="energyFill" style="width: 100%"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="energy-labels">
                        <span>CRITICAL</span>
                        <span>THROTTLE</span>
                        <span>OPTIMAL</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="panel-title" style="margin-top: 2rem">⚙️ QUICK ACTIONS</div>
                
                <div class="quick-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn" onclick="MagicChat.checkHealth()">
                        🔍 Health Check
                    </button>
                    <button class="action-btn" onclick="MagicChat.verifyIntegrity()">
                        🔐 Verify Chain
                    </button>
                    <button class="action-btn" onclick="MagicChat.exportAudit()">
                        📊 Export Audit
                    </button>
                    <button class="action-btn danger" onclick="MagicChat.invokeChaos()">
                        💥 Invoke Chaos
                    </button>
                </div>
                
                <div class="panel-title" style="margin-top: 2rem">📊 SYSTEM STATUS</div>
                
                <div class="system-status">
                    <div class="status-item">
                        <div class="status-item-label">Requests</div>
                        <div class="status-item-value" id="requestCount">0</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="status-item">
                        <div class="status-item-label">Errors</div>
                        <div class="status-item-value" id="errorCount">0</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="status-item">
                        <div class="status-item-label">Latency</div>
                        <div class="status-item-value" id="latency">--ms</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="status-item">
                        <div class="status-item-label">Queue</div>
                        <div class="status-item-value" id="queueSize">0</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Chat Panel -->
            <div class="panel chat-container">
                <div class="panel-title">💬 MAGIC CHAT // AGENT-99 INTERFACE</div>
                
                <div class="chat-messages" id="chatMessages">
                    <div class="message ai">
                        <div class="message-avatar">🦅</div>
                        <div class="message-content">
                            <div class="message-text">
                                <strong>PHOENIX EMPIRE ONLINE</strong><br><br>
                                Welcome, AGENT-100. All systems nominal. Ledger integrity verified. 
                                MPCP governance active. Awaiting your command.
                            </div>
                            <div class="message-time" id="initTime"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="typing-indicator" id="typingIndicator">
                    <div class="typing-dot"></div>
                    <div class="typing-dot"></div>
                    <div class="typing-dot"></div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="chat-input-container">
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        class="chat-input" 
                        id="chatInput" 
                        placeholder="Enter your command, AGENT-100..."
                        autocomplete="off"
                    />
                    <button class="send-btn" id="sendBtn" onclick="MagicChat.sendMessage()">
                        SEND
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        // =====================================================================
        // MAGIC CHAT ENGINE
        // =====================================================================
        
        const MagicChat = {
            config: {
                workerUrl: 'https://phoenix-empire.mrmichaelhobbs1234.workers.dev',
                apiKey: 'agent-100-sovereign-michael-hobbs-phoenix-empire-key',
                pollInterval: 2000
            },
            
            stats: {
                requests: 0,
                errors: 0,
                startTime: Date.now()
            },
            
            init() {
                this.setupEventListeners();
                this.startMatrixRain();
                this.startSystemMonitor();
                this.updateInitTime();
                
                // Load initial state
                this.loadSystemState();
            },
            
            setupEventListeners() {
                const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
                input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.sendMessage();
                    }
                });
            },
            
            async sendMessage() {
                const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
                const message = input.value.trim();
                
                if (!message) return;
                
                // Add user message to chat
                this.addMessage('user', message);
                input.value = '';
                
                // Show typing indicator
                this.showTyping(true);
                
                // Simulate AI processing
                await this.sleep(1500);
                
                // Process command
                const response = await this.processCommand(message);
                
                // Hide typing indicator
                this.showTyping(false);
                
                // Add AI response
                this.addMessage('ai', response);
            },
            
            async processCommand(message) {
                const lower = message.toLowerCase();
                
                if (lower.includes('status') || lower.includes('health')) {
                    return await this.checkHealth();
                } else if (lower.includes('verify') || lower.includes('integrity')) {
                    return await this.verifyIntegrity();
                } else if (lower.includes('export') || lower.includes('audit')) {
                    return await this.exportAudit();
                } else if (lower.includes('chaos')) {
                    return await this.invokeChaos();
                } else {
                    return this.getGenericResponse(message);
                }
            },
            
            async checkHealth() {
                try {
                    const start = Date.now();
                    const response = await fetch(${this.config.workerUrl}/introspect/health, {
                        headers: {
                            'x-deathstar-key': this.config.apiKey
                        }
                    });
                    
                    const latency = Date.now() - start;
                    const data = await response.json();
                    
                    this.stats.requests++;
                    document.getElementById('latency').textContent = ${latency}ms;
                    
                    return ✅ <strong>Health Check Complete</strong><br><br>
                            Status: ${data.status}<br>
                            Protocol: ${data.protocol}<br>
                            Latency: ${latency}ms<br>
                            All systems nominal.;
                } catch (e) {
                    this.stats.errors++;
                    return ❌ <strong>Health Check Failed</strong><br><br>Error: ${e.message};
                }
            },
            
            async verifyIntegrity() {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(${this.config.workerUrl}/ledger/verify, {
                        headers: {
                            'x-deathstar-key': this.config.apiKey
                        }
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    this.stats.requests++;
                    
                    if (data.ok) {
                        return ✅ <strong>Integrity Verified</strong><br><br>
                                Scanned: ${data.scanned} events<br>
                                Head Hash: ${data.head_hash?.slice(0, 16)}...<br>
                                Chain: INTACT;
                    } else {
                        return ⚠️ <strong>Integrity Issues Detected</strong><br><br>
                                Errors: ${data.errors?.length || 0}<br>
                                Requires investigation.;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    this.stats.errors++;
                    return ❌ <strong>Verification Failed</strong><br><br>Error: ${e.message};
                }
            },
            
            async exportAudit() {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(${this.config.workerUrl}/audit/export?limit=50, {
                        headers: {
                            'x-deathstar-key': this.config.apiKey
                        }
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    this.stats.requests++;
                    
                    // Trigger download
                    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = url;
                    a.download = phoenix-audit-${Date.now()}.json;
                    a.click();
                    
                    return 📊 <strong>Audit Export Complete</strong><br><br>
                            Events exported: ${data.events?.length || 0}<br>
                            Download initiated.;
                } catch (e) {
                    this.stats.errors++;
                    return ❌ <strong>Export Failed</strong><br><br>Error: ${e.message};
                }
            },
            
            async invokeChaos() {
                return 💥 <strong>Chaos Protocol</strong><br><br>
                        Chaos injection requires CHAOS_ENABLED=1 in Worker environment.<br>
                        Current state: DISABLED (fail-safe)<br>
                        Enable via Cloudflare dashboard to activate.;
            },
            
            getGenericResponse(message) {
                const responses = [
                    🦅 <strong>Command Acknowledged</strong><br><br>
                     Processing: "${message}"<br>
                     Ledger updated. Awaiting further instructions.,
                    
                    ⚡ <strong>Phoenix Protocol Active</strong><br><br>
                     Your request has been logged to the immutable ledger.<br>
                     System state: STABLE,
                    
                    🔮 <strong>Analysis Complete</strong><br><br>
                     Input processed through AGENT-99 interface.<br>
                     No critical actions required.
                ];
                
                return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
            },
            
            async loadSystemState() {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(${this.config.workerUrl}/introspect/state, {
                        headers: {
                            'x-deathstar-key': this.config.apiKey
                        }
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    
                    document.getElementById('protocolVersion').textContent = data.protocol || 'OMEGA v1';
                    document.getElementById('ledgerHeight').textContent = data.last_nonce || '--';
                    document.getElementById('systemState').textContent = data.state || 'SHADOW';
                    
                    if (data.energy !== undefined) {
                        this.updateEnergy(data.energy);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('Failed to load system state:', e);
                }
            },
            
            updateEnergy(value) {
                document.getElementById('energyValue').textContent = ${value}%;
                document.getElementById('energyFill').style.width = ${value}%;
                
                // Color coding
                const fill = document.getElementById('energyFill');
                if (value < 30) {
                    fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444 0%, #dc2626 100%)';
                } else if (value < 70) {
                    fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%)';
                } else {
                    fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gospel-purple) 0%, var(--gospel-gold) 100%)';
                }
            },
            
            addMessage(type, text) {
                const messages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
                const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
                
                const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                messageDiv.className = message ${type};
                messageDiv.innerHTML = 
                    <div class="message-avatar">${type === 'user' ? '👤' : '🦅'}</div>
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <div class="message-text">${text}</div>
                        <div class="message-time">${time}</div>
                    </div>
                ;
                
                messages.appendChild(messageDiv);
                messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
            },
            
            showTyping(show) {
                const indicator = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
                if (show) {
                    indicator.classList.add('active');
                } else {
                    indicator.classList.remove('active');
                }
            },
            
            startSystemMonitor() {
                setInterval(() => {
                    // Update uptime
                    const elapsed = Date.now() - this.stats.startTime;
                    const hours = Math.floor(elapsed / 3600000);
                    const minutes = Math.floor((elapsed % 3600000) / 60000);
                    const seconds = Math.floor((elapsed % 60000) / 1000);
                    document.getElementById('uptime').textContent = 
                        ${hours.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')};
                    
                    // Update stats
                    document.getElementById('requestCount').textContent = this.stats.requests;
                    document.getElementById('errorCount').textContent = this.stats.errors;
                    
                    // Reload system state
                    this.loadSystemState();
                }, this.config.pollInterval);
            },
            
            updateInitTime() {
                document.getElementById('initTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            },
            
            startMatrixRain() {
                const canvas = document.getElementById('matrixCanvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                
                canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
                
                const chars = '0123456789ABCDEF⚡🦅💎';
                const fontSize = 14;
                const columns = canvas.width / fontSize;
                const drops = Array(Math.floor(columns)).fill(1);
                
                function draw() {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
                    ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';
                    
                    for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                        const text = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
                        ctx.fillText(text, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);
                        
                        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
                            drops[i] = 0;
                        }
                        drops[i]++;
                    }
                }
                
                setInterval(draw, 50);
                
                window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
                });
            },
            
            sleep(ms) {
                return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
            }
        };
        
        // Initialize on load
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            MagicChat.init();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------

const VERSION = "BIBLE_BUILDER_V2.0.0";
const BUILD_ID = "PHOENIX_BIBLE_V2_REINCARNATION";
const FAIL = (m) => { throw new Error("HALT::" + m); };

const MODES = Object.freeze({
  BUILD: "BUILD",
  AUDIT: "AUDIT",
  SEAL:  "SEAL"
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 1) KERNEL STATE (STATELESS BY DESIGN; DERIVED EACH RUN)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const Kernel = {
  mode: MODES.BUILD,
  registry: {
    sources: [],
    buckets: {},
    books: [],
    rules: [],
    glossary: [],
    provenance: []
  },
  locks: {
    assumptionsUsed: 0,
    sealed: false
  }
};

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2) SOURCE INGEST (LEDGER CONSOLIDATION INPUTS)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ingestSources(payload){
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") FAIL("INVALID_INGEST");
  const keys = [
    "monoliths","scripts","interfaces","docs","executions","auth","claims"
  ];
  keys.forEach(k => Kernel.registry.sources.push({ type:k, data: payload[k]||[] }));
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3) NORMALIZATION (NO JUDGMENT)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function normalize(){
  Kernel.registry.buckets = {
    MONOLITH_SOURCES: [],
    SCRIPT_SOURCES: [],
    INTERFACE_SOURCES: [],
    DOC_SOURCES: [],
    EXECUTION_PATTERNS: [],
    AUTH_VARIANTS: [],
    CLAIMS: []
  };

  for (const s of Kernel.registry.sources){
    switch(s.type){
      case "monoliths": Kernel.registry.buckets.MONOLITH_SOURCES.push(...s.data); break;
      case "scripts":   Kernel.registry.buckets.SCRIPT_SOURCES.push(...s.data); break;
      case "interfaces":Kernel.registry.buckets.INTERFACE_SOURCES.push(...s.data); break;
      case "docs":      Kernel.registry.buckets.DOC_SOURCES.push(...s.data); break;
      case "executions":Kernel.registry.buckets.EXECUTION_PATTERNS.push(...s.data); break;
      case "auth":      Kernel.registry.buckets.AUTH_VARIANTS.push(...s.data); break;
      case "claims":    Kernel.registry.buckets.CLAIMS.push(...s.data); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------

function setMode(m){

}
